'''Mokshok''' was a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] and, later, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].

==Biography==
Mokshok served as the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], a role in which he had to attend innumerable meetings, attend to protocol, and wear ceremonial garb.<ref name="BHP 8">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]'', Chapter 8.</ref> By the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], however, Mokshok served as the first mate of the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Pirates]], under the leadership of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr]], a role he held for a long period of time. After the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was added to the Black Hole's roster, Mokshok found himself having to resist the newcomer's efforts to usurp the Swokes Swokes's authority. In one incident, for instance, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had just been taken aboard the pirates' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Random Mallet]]'', convinced Mokshok that Bossk had been talking ill about him. This eventually prompted the Swokes Swokes to punch the Transoshan and knock him unconscious.<ref name="BHP 7">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]'', Chapter 7.</ref> Nevertheless, Bossk eventually managed to remove the Swokes Swokes from power and become Mcgrrr's new first mate.<ref name="BHP 9">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]'', Chapter 9.</ref>
